method: Same process, one warmup and five samples per workload; medians. Baseline is the pre-change dist compiled from .refactor/baseline/src. Node 22.23.2 on win32 x64.

workloads.emit: 20,000 non-durable events for one run with a warm run index

scope: Microbenchmarks only. They exclude provider network latency, model inference, disk contention and full agent runs.
notable: Headless runs with no live SSE subscriber now skip ephemeral delta allocation/redaction entirely via Store.emitEphemeral; this is not captured by the emit microbenchmark because it measures the listener-present path.
